steps.content: Shin is gone. And with her goes the infinite torso of the Abyss, the shadow of the false land.
Only you and Pylgia are left in the wheelhouse. Those horrific memories carved into your soul are like phantoms that never existed.
But you know, with despair, that they aren't phantoms. The shattered portholes, the dead control panels, and the congealed alien matter are all proof.
Now, where is the ship supposed to go? You don't know. The fog has lifted, yet all you can see is the endless ocean. There are no stars to guide you, no landmarks to show the way.
Of course, even if there were, you wouldn't dare trust them again. You can only drift aimlessly with this ship across these loathsome, unending waters, waiting for inevitable death.
[Fade to Black, Show Schorl]
Deep in your consciousness, a blue light flickers. Ah, that's right. You won't die here. Unlike the crew, you always have an escape route. The illusion can't truly kill you.
Then why fight at all? Why make any choices? Everything you've done has been proven wrong.
Or perhaps your presence here is a mistake.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: No fuel... We need to prepare for a long drift.
Pylgia's voice reaches your ear, cutting through your muddled thoughts.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Even without power, the tides will eventually carry us to shore. It's just a matter of time.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Don't be afraid. I'm still here. Even if it's just the two of us, I promise I'll get you back.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: As long as we're alive... there will always be hope.
She glances at the broken, drafty portholes, then extends a hand to you.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: We can't stay here. We'll freeze. Come with me.
Pylgia is the only one speaking in the wheelhouse, but it takes a long time for her words to penetrate the fog in your mind.
She wants to take you away. She hasn't given up. She's fighting this destined end?
But what's the point?
The blue light flickers incessantly in the depths of your mind. Your body is as stiff as a stone statue, leaving Pylgia's hand suspended in the air.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: We... can't let Shin's sacrifice be in vain.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Do you remember what happened in the Abyss? When I wanted to give up being human... you didn't give up on me... If it hadn't been for you, I would never have made it back.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: So... trust me, and believe in yourself. Don't give up, okay?
Her voice is almost pleading by the end, bringing a moment of clarity to your murky mind.
You could give up and walk away. But what about Pylgia?
If you leave now, would you ever see her again? What would become of her fate?
You don't know, but you don't have the slightest courage to find out.
In your daze, you grasp her outstretched hand. Her damp palm still carries human warmth.
You let her lead you toward whatever unknown awaits.
